content: Qoho Yarshoy Shiiqiza Gaasota
«Issaadey ba be7ida miishshe markkattana mala pirda pirdizaso xeygettidi ba be7idayssa woykko ba erizayssa markkattontta ixxiko hessi izas nagara gidana; hessa gishshas izaadey oyshettana.
«Ay asikka erontta dishe wogan digettida do7ata bawuta, meheta bawuta woykko tiran biittara gooshettiza medheteththata bawuta bochchidaadey tunees; hessika izaades nagara gidees.
«Ay asikka erontta dishin asappe goggi kezidi tunisiza miish bochchiko izaadey hessa erida gallassafe doommidi izas nagara gidees.
«Ay asikka iitas gidiin kiyas gidiin yuushshi qoppontta coo mela adina adinettiko izaadey ooththida mooroza zaari akeekida wodeppe doommidi izaades nagara gidana.
«Ay asikka hayta ha miishshatappe issaan qohi beettiko ba nagara qonccisi paaxanaas bessees.
Izaadey ba nagaraa gishshas macca dors woykko macca deysh yarshanaas eho; qeeseykka izappe ekkidi izaade nagara wursanaas GODAA sinththan yarsho.

«Ay asikka ba ooththida nagara gishshas dors woykko deyshe shiishshanaas dandayonttaaz gidikko nam7u haraphpheta woykko haraphphe ciyeta ehidi issiniyo nagara yarshos nam7anththayokka xuugettiza yarshos Xoossa sinth shiishsho.
Ehidi qeesezas immo; qeesezikka qoho yarshos shiiqiza kafoy qoodhe qanxxontta mirqqidi qoho yarshos shiishsho.
Suuththaafe guuththara ekkidi yarsho yarshozasoza bolla yuuyi aadhdhanaas wuxxo; attida suuththaa yarsho yarshizaso garsan wuxxo; hessika nagara wurso yarsho gidana.
Hankko attida kafoyo diza wogaa mala xuugettiza yarsho histti shiishsho; hessaththo ooththidi qeesezi izaade nagaraa wursanaas yarsho; iita ooththidaades iza nagaray atto geetettana.
Izaadey nam7u haraphpheta shiishshanaas dandayonttayssa gidikko ba nagaraa gishshas issi kilo liiqo dhiille eho; hessika nagara yarshos gidiza gishshas wogara zaytey woykko exaaney izan gujettofo.

Izakka ehidi qeesezas immo; qeesezikka he dhiillezappe ba kushen kuphphati ekkidi GODAAS shiiqiza kaththa yarshora issife gaththi hassa7issanaas yarsho yarshizasoza bolla xuuggo; hessika nagara gishshas shiiqiza yarsho.

Ay asikka haytantta mala nagaratappe issaa ooththiko qeesezi hessa mala ooththidi izaadey ooththida nagaraa wursanaas yarsho shiishsho; hessaadeska atto geetettana; hankko attida dhiilley kaththa yarshoy qeesezas attiza mala izas gido.»
Qoho Gishshas Shiiqiza Yarsho Shiisho Maara
GODAY Muses hizgides,

«Ay asikka GODAAS immanaas bessizayssa erontta aggidi immontta aggiko izas nagara gidida gishshas issi wosoy iza bolla baynda dharsho qohos gidiza yarsho GODAAS shiishsho; iza waaga heregaykka kase Xoossa Keeththan erettida herega mala gido; hessika qoho gishshas shiiqiza yarsho.

GODAAS immanaas bessishin izaadey immontta aggidayssa ciggo; hessafekka bollara hayssa ha heregaas ichchashaappe issi kushe gujjidi qeesezikka izi ehida dharshaara gaaggidi nagara yarsho ooththidi ehidaade nagara wursana; he mooro ooththidayssi atto geetettana.
«Ay asikka erontta dishe GODAY ooththofte gida azazotappe issiniyo moorikko izaades nagara; he nagaraa gishshas izaadey oyshettana.

Izaadeyka ba moorida mooroza gishshas ba meheta giddofe iza bolla issi wosoy baynda dharsho qeesezakko eho; izi ehidayssa wogay kase qoho yarshos ciggiza waaga kessizaaz gido; qeesezikka hessaththo asi erontta ooththida mooroza geeshsho; izaadeyka maarettana.
Hessika qoho gishshas shiiqiza yarsho; izaadeyka GODAA sinththan mooro ooththida gishshas nagaranchcha.»
